_comment: The static reference pages (scripts/seo/build.mjs) — ONE list, read by the generator, the sitemap, the service worker's navigation denylist in vite.config.ts, the app footer and the pages' own nav. `published: false` means the section is spoken for but has no page yet: it is still kept out of the SPA navigation fallback, so the day its page lands nobody's warm service worker answers it with the app shell, but nothing links to it and it stays out of the sitemap. Add a section here first. `primary` marks the handful that fit in a header nav; every published section is linked from the footer regardless.
